# jfrader-ui

From-scratch React component system. Emotion for styling, CSS custom properties for theming, Storybook
10 as the workbench. pnpm monorepo, ESM, TypeScript strict, React 19. Pre-1.0.

## Packages

- @jfrader/tokens (packages/tokens): typed token source, generated CSS vars and typed var() references
- @jfrader/styling (packages/styling): shared Emotion seam, sx, theme typing, and media queries over tokens
- @jfrader/icons (packages/icons): SvgIcon, createSvgIcon, SVG sources, generated React icons, and searchable metadata; depends on styling and tokens, below ui
- @jfrader/ui (packages/ui): React components over icons and styling; re-exports SvgIcon and createSvgIcon
- @jfrader/storybook (apps/storybook): workbench, component docs, browser tests
- @jfrader/docs (apps/docs): documentation site published at ui.jfrader.com
- @jfrader/pilot (apps/pilot): reference Vite consumer app

## Key paths

- Token source: packages/tokens/src/tokens.ts
- Token generator: packages/tokens/scripts/generate.ts
- Generated CSS vars: packages/tokens/dist/tokens.css (import as @jfrader/tokens/tokens.css)
- Generated typed vars: packages/tokens/src/generated/vars.ts (import as @jfrader/tokens/vars)
- Component inventory: packages/ui/src/index.ts
- Components: packages/ui/src/components/<name>/
- Styling seam: packages/styling/src/css.ts (packages/ui/src/styling/ keeps compatibility re-exports)
- Storybook config: apps/storybook/.storybook/
- Game components and procedural scene: opt-in subpaths (@jfrader/ui/game-table, @jfrader/ui/scene, and so on), not re-exported by the root barrel

## Docs

- Consumer setup: docs/getting-started.md
- Theming: docs/theming.md
- Styling: docs/styling.md
- Manual QA gates: docs/qa-gates.md

- Agent conventions: AGENTS.md
- Component authoring and documentation spec: SKILL.md

## Commands

- pnpm generate: generate tokens.css and vars.ts
- pnpm dev: generate tokens and start Storybook on port 6006
- pnpm build: generate tokens and build static Storybook
- pnpm test: generate tokens and run Storybook browser tests
- pnpm typecheck: generate tokens and typecheck every package
- pnpm verify:docs: check component documentation coverage
- pnpm verify:api: check sx-only public styling types, slot props and authored examples
- pnpm verify:slots: check that every declared replacement key is rendered
- pnpm verify:exports: validate UI source subpath exports and their target files
- pnpm og:image: regenerate the Open Graph share card

## Styling rule

Components consume semantic --ui-* variables through @jfrader/tokens/vars. No raw colors outside
packages/tokens.
